title: Jet-Black Jungle
description: Recolors jungle wood to a dark, smoky shade
body:
This pack recolors jungle wood to be a smoky, dark shade that works well alongside many other block palettes.

![Jungle wood has been recolored to a dark, ebony shade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9aa05f06b19e726f19049f727fd0a610b0a8ad8f.jpeg)

It includes compat for the following mods:

- Another Furniture
- Architect's Palette
- Balanced Crates
- The Block Box
- Boatload
- Bountiful Fares
- Building But Better
- Cozy
- Create
- Decorative Blocks
- Dramatic Doors
- Farmer's Delight
- Farmer's Assortment
- Friends & Foes
- Hearth and Harvest
- Hearth & Home
- Modern Glass Doors
- MrCrayfish's Furniture Mod: Refurbished
- Player Shops
- Quark
- Re:Deco
- Redecorate
- Shutter Up
- Snowy Spirit
- Storage Delight
- Storage Drawers
- Supplementaries
- Tutta's Doors
- Twigs
- Variant Barrels
- Variant Beehives
- Variant Bookshelves
- Variant Chests
- Variant Chiseled Bookshelves
- Variant Composters
- Variant Crafting Tables
- Woodworks

If you like this pack, check out my other recolors: [Ashy Gray Acacia](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ashy-gray-acacia) and [Mossy Green Mangrove](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mossy-green-mangrove)
